scope: M31-W03-04 BASS diagnostic history and exact-boundary audit

development_findings.observation: ATT error 0x07 followed by stale source cache and re-add -EINVAL
development_findings.cause_boundary: fixed SDK read parameter union retained a previous write offset and the cached source survived removal
development_findings.resolution: removed the manual read API and command; receive-state notifications remain the public state path

development_findings.observation: development control run passed 16 cycles then re-add did not reach PA/BIS sync while the source advanced from 93300 to 94300 frames
development_findings.resolution: wait for the periodic termination callback before reusing the controller resource

development_findings.observation: development run passed 10 cycles then reported receive state pa=0 bis=1 and native=-104 at step=11
development_findings.resolution: mark accepted PA/BIS termination requests as stopping before Arduino poll, preserve the HCI reason, and use the SDK reference timeout ratio 20

development_findings.observation: clean target run completed 13 cycles then a child Python process exited with Windows status 0xC0000005 before target output
development_findings.target_observation: source advanced 11200 to 12600 and delegator advanced 8900 to 10300 with dropped=0
development_findings.resolution: keep both COM ports open in one bounded process and join reader threads before closing handles
